jobs.name: two-commas
jobs.sentence: Put commas around a bare variable letter. "The coupling constant, K, is…" — without the breaks the letter runs into the next word. Fix it in the text, not with overrides.
jobs.claim: Two commas in the text add a pause before K that the bare sentence does not have. Measured by the maker over 40 takes (four voices, ten seeds each): a quiet stretch of 50 ms or more before K in 0 of 40 bare takes and 40 of 40 with commas. Both versions already have a pause after K, 220 to 360 ms bare. On the page: punctuation changes prosody (Iteration Character, step 1; the Charter) and the comma fix itself; Loudon's recorded words in tuning item 7 ask for the pause 'before the variable name'. The direction (before, not after) is the maker's finding and differs from the page's wording 'runs into the next word'.
